support.quote: The first recipient of the FIFA World Player Trophy was Germany’s Lothar Matthaus back in 1991, when he was starring for Inter Milan.
took the inaugural FIFA World Player of the Year prize in 1991 after scoring 23 goals in all competitions for Inter during the 1990/91 campaign
While Lionel Messi has picked up one more World Player award than Cristiano Ronaldo (six compared to five), the pair have each been runner-up on six occasions.

assessments.note: Written in 2020, after Messi's sixth (September 2019): before that award both stood at five, which is the card's count. Since then Messi has won 2022 and 2023 too (eight).

support.quote: That’s five awards apiece for him and Messi, the Argentinian’s golden period coming when he won four in a row between 2009 and 2012.

assessments.note: Five each after October 2017; Modrić won 2018, so the tie held until Messi's sixth in September 2019.
